column1: # ap: apply * (deref) or [ (index) to the type whose descriptor starts AT (its first two constructors, or int):
#   next  the operator reaches the type held (a pointer's target, an array's element)
#   same  the type stays (*f is the function f: it decays to a pointer and is dereferenced back)
#   none  not C (an int is neither; a function cannot be indexed; arithmetic on a pointer to a function is not C)
# AT lists only the prefixes of valid descriptors (adj), so every key is one the derivation can ask.
